scope: Only the new acceptance/news_api_sample_v2 source directory was changed; backend/frontend/scripts and v1 executor/plan were not edited.
changes: Lazy Windows tkinter masked input with Ctrl+V/right-click paste and visible character count
Printable ASCII key-format validation, explicit cancellation and closed-window reentry prevention
Synthetic-only standalone UI entry without backend/runner/plan import, with socket/DNS blocked
Allowlisted integer HTTP status and UTC/monotonic timing receipt; no headers/error body/credential persistence
Explicit PythonExecutable launcher parameter; no plaintext completion prompt
Bounded rejected-HTTP-body drain avoids Windows connection reset on denied local routes

tests.initial_runner_result: 7 passed and one Windows local connection-aborted error while rejecting a wrong item route; fixed bounded rejected-body draining before final successful run.

limitations: MockTk tests do not establish visual/clipboard behavior of the actual Windows dialog; separate synthetic-only UI verification remains available.
Character count and ASCII validation do not verify whether a key is valid and do not explain the v1 HTTP failure.
45 seconds is a socket timeout, not an end-to-end wall-clock deadline.
Application reservation upper bound 0.124536 CNY is not a supplier billing hard cap.
One-shot control belongs to this isolated executor, not the production general session API.
No second real model request was authorized or executed as part of this implementation.
